updateMessage: Movie Hub v3.5.268 is live! Instant playback on movie/series click, ~90 MB build, plus all existing 360p/720p HD quality & stability fixes.
releaseNotes: v3.5.268: Clicking any movie or series now starts playback immediately, ~90 MB APK build with zero feature changes, plus calibrated 360p/720p HD, resume on quality switch, all-format support, and improved in-app APK installer.
